newsitem.title: UK: London stocks open firm, bolstered by Dow record.
newsitem.headline: London stocks open firm, bolstered by Dow record.

text.p: UK shares got off to a strong start on Thursday, lifted by another record close on Wall Street to be just a few points short of the all-time high set earlier this week.

The FTSE 100 index of leading shares was up 14.4 points at 4,056.5 by 0741 GMT. Its best ever level of 4,063.2 was set on Tuesday. "We're likely to continue onwards and upwards," said one dealer, "But not with too much gusto."
Wall Street was propelled to its 30th record close of the year after signs of an economic softening from the latest batch of U.S. data and continuing strong third quarter earnings.
